About this product

The AJAX-MP-OUT-W, also known as the Ajax MotionProtect Outdoor, is a wireless outdoor motion detector. It features an advanced anti-masking system and pet immunity, making it ideal for outdoor security. The detector has a detection range of up to 15 meters and a horizontal coverage of 90 degrees. It also offers three adjustable sensitivity levels and a battery life of up to 5 years.
